about.title: Building Secure Payment & Backend Systems
about.description: I am an Associate Software Developer at Aurus Inc., contributing to fintech payment infrastructure within the ECST team. My work includes iFrame PayPage integrations, wallet transaction flows, merchant validation systems, and one-time token generation for downstream transaction processing. Currently involved in migrating utility configuration systems to Infinispan Cache and MariaDB to improve performance and maintainability.

projects.heading: Featured Projects
projects.description: Backend-focused and production-oriented applications showcasing experience in fintech systems, authentication workflows, distributed services, and full-stack development.

list.title: iFrame PayPage & Tokenization — Aurus Inc.
list.description: Working within the ECST team at Aurus Inc. on secure iFrame-based PayPage integrations for merchant payment workflows. Contributed to wallet transaction handling, merchant validation pipelines, and generation of one-time secure tokens for downstream transaction processing.

list.title: SaleZone — E-Commerce Platform
list.description: Full-stack e-commerce platform implementing JWT authentication, product catalog management, cart workflows, order processing, and Razorpay payment integration. Built using a React frontend and Spring Boot REST APIs with MySQL persistence.

list.title: EasyBuy — Microservices E-Commerce
list.description: Microservices-based e-commerce system designed with independently deployable services including User, Product, Inventory, Cart, Payment, Notification, and AI modules. Built using Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Docker, and Spring Cloud for distributed service communication.

list.title: Auth App — Full Stack Authentication
list.description: Authentication platform implementing secure user registration, JWT-based authorization, login workflows, and protected route handling using Spring Security, React, and TypeScript.

list.title: BlogBrew — Blogging Platform
list.description: Full-stack blogging platform implementing authentication, CRUD operations, pagination, and responsive UI design. Deployed using AWS Elastic Beanstalk with MySQL hosted on AWS RDS.

list.title: Conversational AI App
list.description: AI-powered conversational application integrating Google Gemini API with Flask backend services and MongoDB-based chat persistence. Includes authentication, response caching, and optimized repeated-query handling to reduce unnecessary external API requests.
